name: Digilogic Systems Limited
sector: Defence test/measurement integration; proposed electronic manufacturing
summary: Digilogic is a specialized defence test-system integrator attempting a larger manufacturing expansion. Long-run organic growth and improved latest cash collection are strengths; four-year CFO/PAT only 4.2%, high family compensation and a land-condition versus commissioning timing mismatch are decisive risks. This is an execution-sensitive growth thesis, not a demonstrated compounder. At secondary 186.05, current-share trailing P/E about 51.65 already requires substantial delivery; IAS remains NS despite linked scenarios. Clarified land compliance, funded progress and repeat cash realization could change the conclusion. [S1][S2][S7][S8][S13]

score_note: GQS capped 5 for persistent cash weakness; IAS NS with linked scenarios and unresolved material project conditions.

GOV.reason: Current promoter ownership and encumbrance evidence are available; restatements and overturned orders are explained. High family compensation, approved variable increases, cyber security loss and broad related-lending authority weaken minority/control assessment. No verified diversion or continuing 26 crore penalty established.

MOAT.reason: Specialized engineering and embedded defence test-system expertise support switching/qualification friction. High top-customer concentration, dependence on imported OEM hardware and unproven new manufacturing prevent stronger score; named defence customers alone do not establish pricing power.

REV.reason: Primary five-year organic revenue CAGR 31.03% qualifies 9 before medium-confidence cap 8. New subsidiary postdates history and is immaterial initially; no large acquired revenue distortion. Latest 7.45% growth is slower but no two-half/four-quarter evidence supports a mechanical trajectory adjustment.

DUR.reason: Defence qualification and test-system lifecycle provide repeat demand; Udaan expands addressable capabilities.31 crore backlog versus 77 crore sales and 110 crore unawarded tenders do not secure five-year growth; imported supply and timing condition constrain visibility.

CAP.reason: Core earnings have grown and historical capital-return diagnostic is positive. Project-earmarked cash subtraction flatters returns; new factory and noncore guesthouse absorb capital before proven incremental cash earnings. Land title condition and lower incremental return limit score.

CASH.reason: FY 2026 CFO 12.63 is genuine improvement and WIP fell, not a stock-led profit boost. Four-year CFO/PAT only 4.2%, high receivables and repeated negative years indicate persistent weak conversion; latest CFO does not erase history. GQS cap 5 applies.

BAL.reason: IPO reduced debt to 4.06 and funded planned project deposits; no large convertible overhang disclosed. Most 51.94 crore deposits are earmarked, not surplus, while cost overruns/working capital can consume liquidity; score not based on gross-cash headline alone.

EXEC.reason: Established deliveries and FY 2026 CFO rebound support capability. Missed FY 2026 guidance, imported-component delays and incompatible-looking land versus production schedules weaken delivery confidence. Construction progress is management report, not independent completion certification.

EARN.reason: Profit rises faster than sales with software-rich mix and lower material content; depreciation/interest and prior-credit normalization disclosed. Persistently low multi year realization, prior-period credit and higher approved family pay limit durability of current margin.

L.reason: Observed secondary turnover lower-bound proxies support small-position exit at modest participation. One lot consumes 44.65% of reference allocation, concentration and live depth/spread are unverified, and no BSE regulatory clearance is assumed.

R.reason: Material low-confidence inputs are compliance or extension of the land invoicing condition, project commissioning timing and cost, incremental manufacturing returns and currently usable project cash. These can invalidate the operating/funding path, so the conditional cases do not support point return, downside or market-expectation factors. Reassessed against the corrected opening-claim cash/debt cases dated 20 October 2026; the identified material evidence gaps remain, so this factor is still NS.

sections.title: Executive Verdict
sections.text: Digilogic is a specialized defence test-system integrator attempting a larger manufacturing expansion. Long-run organic growth and improved latest cash collection are strengths; four-year CFO/PAT only 4.2%, high family compensation and a land-condition versus commissioning timing mismatch are decisive risks. This is an execution-sensitive growth thesis, not a demonstrated compounder. At secondary 186.05, current-share trailing P/E about 51.65 already requires substantial delivery; IAS remains NS despite linked scenarios. Clarified land compliance, funded progress and repeat cash realization could change the conclusion. [S1][S2][S7][S8][S13]

sections.title: Research Header, Gates and Data Confidence
sections.text: BSE SME 544684, ISIN INE1OOT01028, FV 2,28,951,030 shares; January 2026 IPO. March financials standalone; new 80%-owned Abhedhya began May 23 with 4 lakh investment, not material historical acquired sales. Cutoff 20 October 2026; latest secondary close 19 October 186.05 implies 538.63 crore market cap. Five-year horizon,15% nominal pretax equity hurdle and 5 lakh reference position. G1 no verified critical fail; G2 no critical reliability hold because cash/restatement bridges reconcile; G3 is Conditional because remaining project costs and funding availability are uncertain; G4 is Conditional because the lot is large and live depth is unverified. High confidence on audited history/current shareholding, medium quality factors, low project valuation. Lot 1200 costs 223260,44.65% of allocation; observed low×volume median 20 supports 1.60-day 5% exit, not an executable guarantee. [S1][S2][S9][S12][S13]

sections.title: Scorecard and Calculation Audit
sections.text: BQS 5.42, GQS raw 6.2 capped 5 for persistent CASH 3; IAS NS. Canonical factors GOV 4, MOAT 6, REV 8, DUR 6, CAP 5, CASH 3, BAL 7, EXEC 5, EARN 5 and L 5 have claim-linked evidence and counter arguments. R/D/P missing are not reweighted; full arithmetic and bounds appear in score_audit. Land uncertainty is an execution/valuation limitation, not invented financial unreliability. [S1][S2][S7]

sections.title: Business Overview
sections.text: Revenue comes from custom test/measurement, ATE/checkouts, simulators, integration and software for defence and aerospace projects, with customer acceptance/milestones determining billing. Imported US/European hardware combines with domestic integration/software value. Customers include defence organizations/PS Us directly or through intermediaries; ultimate end-demand is government defence according to management. Receivables 42.98 crore, about 55.5% annual revenue, show that reported sales are not immediate cash. Udaan adds electronic-subsystem manufacturing and environmental test capabilities rather than merely replicating present integration capacity. [S1][S2][S11]

sections.title: Moat / Industry Position
sections.text: Qualification, custom engineering and installed-system knowledge can create switching friction and recurring upgrades, but no independently quantified market share or pricing moat is established. Defence exposure alone is not differentiation. Top 3 customers 54.58% in FY 2025 and 84.47% in September 2025 half-year make a lost/delayed program material; top 10 reach 96.95% in that half-year. Imported OEM lead-time disruption explains a real failure mode. Large listed defence manufacturers are not directly comparable pure-play peers; applying their multiple without return/scale adjustment is inappropriate. MOAT 6 balances engineering embedded ness against concentration and supplier dependence. [S2][S11]

sections.title: Revenue Growth & Scale
sections.text: FY 2021 primary revenue 20.0427 to FY 2026 77.4314 gives 31.04% five-year CAGR; recent FY 2023/24/25/26 55.9623/51.5593/72.0598/77.4314 shows non-linear delivery. FY 2024 fell 7.87%, FY 2025 grew 39.76%, FY 2026 grew 7.45%; absolute additions−4.4030/+20.5005/+5.3716 crore. No material acquired business or gross pass-through distortion is identified; normal project hardware content does not automatically invalidate revenue. REV 8 reflects the medium-confidence cap on the 31% five-year band. No unsupported trajectory adjustment from a single annual observation. [S1][S2][S3]

sections.title: Growth Quality & Reinvestment Runway
sections.text: May backlog 31 crore, tender pipeline 110 and opportunities 150 are distinct; unawarded tenders are not orders. FY 2027 growth 25–30% and profit 45–50% are management targets after a missed FY 2026 forecast. Udaan 63.7002 crore is partly pre-funded but remaining 51.33 crore consumes IPO deposits; construction, qualifications and customer awards still determine returns. Historical all-cash-deducted NOPAT returns flatter economics because most cash is project-earmarked. GQS cap 5 follows persistent cash weakness despite REV 8. Base 18% growth and 17% EBIT margin are assumptions below sales guidance, not extrapolated management certainty. [S1][S5][S6][S7][S11]

sections.title: Management, Governance & Execution
sections.text: Promoter family 64.26% with no disclosed September encumbrance; FY 2026 family pay/consulting 2.8205 crore is 27.0% PAT. FY 2027 fixed 3.12 crore plus statutory-profit-variable 8% and perks creates a meaningful minority allocation consideration. Section 185: ₹5 crore authority is not evidence of actual transfer. FY 2025 cyber loss 0.4517 crore was expensed, with issuer-reported FIR and control changes; this is a control event, not alleged promoter theft. Annual reports April 22 ROC 26 crore aggregate orders set aside May 4 and nil subsisting, plus 62500 rupees paid in other matters. Presenting 26 crore as current penalty would be wrong. Execution record: February FY 2026 guide 84–90 versus actual 77.43; May/September Udaan December 2027 versus June mid 2028 language, with land invoicing deadline August 2027 unresolved. [S1][S2][S8][S9][S10][S11]

sections.title: Financial Forensics
sections.text: FY 2026 PAT 10.4297 includes 0.3107 prior-period credit; core EBIT 14.0091 and EBITDA 15.8211 exclude other income/prior credit. FY 2025 PAT restatement 7.7934 to 8.1135 has explicit 32.01 lakh bridge, not unexplained economics. CFO 12.6309 rebounds after prior negative years, but four-year cumulative 0.9576 is 4.20% cumulative PAT. Inventory/WIP fell, supporting cash improvement rather than capitalized-stock profit inflation; debtors remain 42.9776 including 2.3134 aged 1–2 years. Cash capex 15.0270 exceeds CFO; economic capex also includes 0.5987 capitalized interest, principally guesthouse borrowing per June call. Gross 54.3816 cash includes 51.94 IPO deposits and 2.0877 margin; 0.0532 earmark explains small CF/cash-equivalent definition difference. Actual model WC 32.7902 is built from notes, excluding tax/financing/related advances; no forecast ratio applied backward. New-share EPS 3.6025 differs from annual weighted 4. 45. [S1][S2][S4][S11]

sections.title: Valuation & Market Expectations
sections.text: Secondary 186.05 gives market cap 538.63 crore and trailing current-share P/E 51.65, not the lower multiple obtained with weighted 4.45 EPS. Five annual linked scenarios start actual March usable/project cash 52.2407, debt 4.0619 and note-built WC, add no IPO again, spend remaining 51.33 project over three years plus maintenance/nonproject commitments, and fund cash deficits at assumed 11% debt cost. Bear/base/bull growth 8/18/25%, EBIT 12/17/20%, terminal 8/12/16×EBITDA are analyst sensitivities. Terminal EV bridges to equity with actual modeled cash/debt and 1.08 GCP reserve; dividends zero. Forecast pay pressure is absorbed in margin assumptions. These are not calibrated fair-value probabilities given land condition and manufacturing economics; R/D/P and IAS NS. Growth/multiple and hurdle sensitivities are supplied, not a buy zone. [S1][S7][S9][S13] Model correction dated 20 October 2026: the earlier forecast omitted certain opening liabilities excluded from operating working capital. The revised model pays opening net tax and other current claims once, preserves actual opening assets/debt, and leaves employee provisions already captured in working capital unchanged. This corrects our forecast, not the issuer’s financial statements. No liability is paid twice through working capital, debt, capex or recurring compensation. Corrected bear/base/bull terminal prices are ₹39.79/₹150.28/₹309.79; corresponding five-year returns are -26.54%/-4.18%/10.74%. These remain conditional operating and funding scenarios, not executable entry prices. Opening-claim amounts, timing alternatives and annual cash/debt checks are in the model. [S1]

sections.title: Bear Case & Permanent-Loss Path
sections.text: The strongest bear case is not merely a high multiple: the factory misses qualifying invoicing by August 2027, requiring an unverified extension or threatening title transfer, while delays trap imported components and receivables. Spend can outrun earmarked deposits; increased remuneration and weak utilization compress cash margin, forcing funding and permanent dilution. Severe model combines−5% growth,9% EBIT,70% WC,30% project overrun and 5×exit, with debt draws explicitly assumed available. It is not a legal asset-recovery floor; denial of title/funding could be worse. Counter evidence is verified debt reduction, existing engineering deliveries, funded deposits and latest CFO improvement. [S1][S7][S8][S11] Impairment is a noncash opening-asset loss. The model reduces usable opening working capital and includes replacement funding once in delta WC, rather than treating a write-off as a separate cash payment; any contingent tax/legal settlement remains a separate cash item.

sections.title: 5× / 10× Feasibility
sections.text: Five-year 5× requires 37.97% annual per-share appreciation;10×58.49%. Historical sales 31% CAGR is below either, latest 7.45% much lower, and current 51.65×trailing earnings already capitalizes future growth. Udaan management projections are not contracted revenue. Absent major sustainable per-share cash growth and retained high exit multiple, neither outcome is established; no unsupported multibagger probability assigned. [S1][S3][S6][S13]

sections.title: Monitoring Plan
sections.text: 1. Obtain written land-condition extension or qualifying invoice evidence before August 1 2027; do not assume ownership from possession. 2. Verify construction/machine orders against December 2027 production target and reconcile conflicting June wording. 3. Track remaining 51.33 crore project spend and cost overruns, not deposit headline. 4. Require actual order conversion versus 31 crore May backlog and 110 crore tenders. 5. Track 2.3134 crore aged debtors and total 42.9776 collections. 6. Test repeat positive CFO and four-year 4.2% conversion improvement. 7. Measure software mix/core EBIT after increased family pay. 8. Check 5 crore related-lending authority for actual transactions. 9. Refresh BSE restrictions/live depth and lot before allocation. 10. Verify Abhedhya investment/revenue and minority economics rather than extrapolating initial 4 lakh. [S1][S5][S7][S8][S9][S11][S13]

sections.title: Final Classification & Conditional Action
sections.text: Execution-sensitive growth watchlist, not compounder or invest able IAS rank. Quality factors are score able with medium confidence and GQS 5 cash cap; uncertain land condition/timing and new-factory returns prevent calibrated valuation. Current high trailing multiple increases required delivery, but no automatic integrity/financial reliability failure is inferred. Reassess on written land compliance, current project funding and two reporting periods of sustainable collections; a lower price alone cannot resolve title/execution uncertainty. This research does not execute an investment transaction.

sections.title: Sources, Assumptions & Open Questions
sections.text: Primary annuals, final prospectus, monitoring report, shareholder/voting filings and dated calls/AGM were read. FY 2021 scanned summary visually checked supports five-year baseline; restatement versions retained. Issuer directories and targeted searches did not establish a land-condition extension; June call adds ambiguous mid 2028 timing, not proof of extension. Primary BSE turnover/surveillance/depth absent; secondary OHLCV explicitly labeled. Remaining project timing, sustainable margin, future WC ratios, financing availability and exit multiple dominate scenarios. Cash starts at March, not claimed current October; no management-guidance or tender value masquerades as realized sales. [S1][S2][S3][S4][S5][S6][S7][S8][S9][S10][S11][S12][S13]

Interest equals the stated annual rate times opening gross debt plus half of current-year draws minus half of repayments. Interest, cash tax, funding draws and repayments are solved simultaneously. The half-year convention is an analyst timing assumption, not a committed financing facility.

Opening receivable/inventory/advance impairment is noncash: reduce opening usable working capital, recognize an earnings charge and add it back in CFO, then fund closing operating working capital from that impaired base. Replacement funding appears once in delta WC. No second cash write-off or tax shield is assumed. DSM separately includes potential tax/legal cash settlements; those are not working-capital write-offs.

Model correction dated 20 October 2026: the earlier forecast omitted certain opening liabilities excluded from operating working capital. The revised model pays opening net tax and other current claims once, preserves actual opening assets/debt, and leaves employee provisions already captured in working capital unchanged.
